If no slice clears, retire the lane; if a slice clears, it becomes a candidate cohort for paper-sleeve ONLY after trading-risk-reviewer approval.

For each slice, compute OOS net-of-cost win rate, bucket calibration/MCE, and ROC-AUC on the OOS fold only, using v_ledger_reward net-of-cost labels (unreconciled rows excluded with documented PIT reason). Tier-1 realized-exit sample n=948 is authoritative; the read-only MERGED sample (Tier-2 trajectory) may be used for diagnostics only — never as calibration authority (per t_83455669 / t_b53a2562 C4 policy).
3. Acceptance gate for a slice: OOS net WR > 53% with n>=300 (or the current promotion bar), monotone bucket ordering, ROC-AUC > 0.55, MCE < 15pp on the OOS fold. Any slice failing the gate is REJECTED and documented.
4. Persist a research note in the Sycode vault (type: research) with the exact SQL, sample sizes, per-slice OOS metrics, multiplicity control, and the honest verdict (calibrated slice found → candidate; none → retire the lane). Link this card and t_13dd5ba0.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Pre-registration exists BEFORE test execution (file or comment timestamp).
- OOS/net-of-cost only; no in-sample slice shopping; every tested slice reported, including failures.
